queries:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT casestat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_conf
  FROM compliancecase
  GROUP BY casestat
),
q AS (
  SELECT casestat, avg_conf
  FROM s
  WHERE avg_conf > (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) FROM s)
)
SELECT casestat, avg_conf, avg_conf / (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) FROM q) AS ratio
FROM q;
SELECT casestat,
       AVG(risksc) AS avg_risksc,
       AVG(risksc) - (SELECT AVG(risksc) FROM compliancecase WHERE casestat IS NOT NULL) AS diff_from_baseline
FROM compliancecase
WHERE casestat IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY casestat;
SELECT AVG(avg_conf) FROM (SELECT casestat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_conf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY casestat HAVING AVG(modelconf) IS NOT NULL)
SELECT casestat,
       AVG(modelconf) - (SELECT AVG(modelconf) FROM compliancecase) AS diff_from_baseline
FROM compliancecase
GROUP BY casestat;
